title: Normalization of coefficient tensor currying
statement: For a site J and coefficient sheaf R and module sheaves in max(c,v,u), assume additive sheafification and WEqualsLocallyBijective and a derived category in universe w. Let S be a coefficient closed structure and T its fixed normalized K-flat tensor models [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. For K-flat complexes P,Q, arbitrary complex I, f:Tot(P,Q)→I and g:P→Hom(Q,I) satisfying the literal sectionwise currying equation [lem-sf-coefficient-cochain-tensor-curry], the inverse S.transpose applied to Q(g composed with Hom(Q,eta_I)) followed by the inverse fixed derived Hom representative isomorphism equals (T.iso(P,Q)).inv composed with Q(f). Here eta_I:I→I(I) is the fixed functorial K-injective augmentation [def-coef-hom-representative-evaluation]. No K-injectivity assumption on I is needed.

proof.text: Postcompose g by Hom(Q,eta_I). Naturality of the product projections shows that its local evaluation formula is the formula for f followed by eta_I.

Apply T.uncurry_model to this map into Hom(Q,I(I)); it yields psi with the same evaluations as f composed with eta_I. Test every tensor summand, use the sheafification adjunction and pure-tensor extensionality to conclude psi = f composed with eta_I.

Substitute that equality into the normalized uncurrying equation. Q(eta_I) is invertible because eta_I is a quasi-isomorphism, and the recorded coefficientHomResolutionInverse is precisely its inverse. Cancel it and precompose with the inverse representative tensor comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientTensorCurry_normalize
    (S : CoefficientClosedStructure (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, u, w} J R))
    (T : CoefficientTensorModels.{u, c, v, w} J R S)
    (P Q I : CochainComplex Mod ℤ)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (R := R) P)
    (hQ : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (R := R) Q)
    (f : (coefficientTotalTensor.{u, c, v} J R).obj (P, Q) ⟶ I)
    (g : P ⟶ homComplex (R := R) Q I)
    (hg : IsCoefficientTensorCurry.{u, c, v} J R P Q I f g) :
    (S.transpose (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q)
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)).symm
      (DerivedCategory.Q.map
          (g ≫ ((homComplexFunctor (R := R)).obj (op Q)).map
            ((coefficientHomAugmentation.{u, c, v} J R).app I)) ≫
        (coefficientHomResolutionIso.{u, c, v, w} J R Q I).inv) =
      (CoefficientTensorModels.iso.{u, c, v, w} J R S T P Q hP hQ).inv ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map f
